summary: Validated public Expo web preview on mobile viewport and core FastAPI endpoints. Health, reads, and SOS/messages/resources/incidents/missing-person POSTs passed. Survivor and volunteer navigation, settings, and task accept tap were exercised.

integration_issues.issue: Expo log repeatedly reports missing expo-sqlite web WASM module ./wa-sqlite/wa-sqlite.wasm. This can break web builds and the offline queue implementation is not reliably available on web.
ACCEPT TASK only opens an Alert and never calls PATCH /api/tasks/{task_id}; task status and assignment are not persisted.

action_items: Fix or conditionally replace expo-sqlite web WASM integration so the Expo web bundle builds cleanly and offline queue works.
Wire volunteer ACCEPT TASK to the existing PATCH task endpoint and refresh task state after success.
Add testID attributes to navigation, status/availability segments, settings controls, photo action, and accept-task buttons for robust regression testing.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/api.ts uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL rather than the requested EXPO_BACKEND_URL; current environment happens to provide the public key, but this is a deployment contract mismatch.
Many interactive Pressable/Switch components lack testID, contrary to the app testing/accessibility convention.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of exercised UI assertions; 2 integration issues found

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ records through SOS, messages, resources, incidents, and missing-person APIs; no cleanup endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL was used. UI persisted role in browser storage, so tests explicitly used Settings > SWITCH ROLE. No authentication required.
rca_of_issue: Expo supervisor logs show the import chain app/index.tsx -> offline.ts -> expo-sqlite -> web worker, which fails resolving the packaged WASM asset. Task acceptance is demonstrably UI-only because PageContent's accept handler calls Alert.alert without api task PATCH.
